user.title: State Announce
user.description: Adds the action “Announce states”. You will find it in every automation and script under Add action.

abort.single_instance_allowed: State Announce is already set up.

not_loaded.message: State Announce is not set up or is disabled.

invalid_target.message: “{target}” is not a valid target. Only notifications (notify) are allowed.

unknown_target.message: The target “{target}” does not exist (anymore). Please select it again in the action.

announce.name: Announce states
announce.description: Checks the selected entities and announces which of them have the wanted state, e.g. which windows are open. No templates needed.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: The entities to check. Their order is also the order in the announcement.

state.name: State
state.description: Which state counts. Windows and doors are open when “On”. You can type custom values like “open” or “home”.

message_one.name: Sentence for one
message_one.description: Used when exactly one entity matches. Placeholder as in the example: names in curly braces is replaced by its name. Empty = sentence for many is used.

message_many.name: Sentence for many
message_many.description: Used when several match. Placeholders in curly braces: names becomes “A, B and C”, count the number.

message_none.name: Sentence for none
message_none.description: Used when none matches. Empty = nothing is sent.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Where the message goes, e.g. Alexa, phone or TV. Multiple allowed.

name_source.name: Name source
name_source.description: Where the spoken name comes from. Set your own names as an alias on the entity (entity settings, voice assistants).

title.name: Title
title.description: Title for phone notifications. Alexa does not read it.

alexa_type.name: Alexa type
alexa_type.description: Only for Alexa targets: normal text to speech or announcement with chime.

report_unavailable.name: Report unreachable
report_unavailable.description: Additionally announces which entities are unreachable.

message_unavailable.name: Sentence for unreachable
message_unavailable.description: Sentence for unreachable entities, placeholders as above. Empty = “Not reachable:” followed by the names.

advanced_options.name: Advanced
advanced_options.description: Name source, title, Alexa and unreachable devices.
